title: Local augmented Koszul carrier
statement: Let i:Z\to Y be a closed immersion of schemes [def-pc-scheme], [def-weil-closed-immersion] with additive tensor pullback [def-pc-module-pullback]. Fix V open in Z and an affine open U in Y. Write A=Gamma(Y,U), I=ker(i)(U) [def-sbc-closed-immersion-ideal-sheaf]. Fix m and f:Fin(m)\to A with span(range(f))=I, and a projective resolution Q of A/I whose chain complex equals the Koszul complex K(A,m,f) [new-j3-koszul-projective-resolution]. Let F be termwise restriction to U, S=(i_*O_Z)[0], and G be termwise tensor pullback along i followed by restriction to V and its over site W=V intersect i^{-1}(U) [lem-sc-homology-evaluation-formal-complex]. There exist a cochain complex K on Y [def-pc-cochain-complex-modules] and an augmentation b:F(K)\to F(S) which is a K-flat resolution [def-pc-kflat-complex], such that G(K) has zero differentials, terms zero outside some finite integer interval, and in every degree a finite free basis over the localized ring sheaf. No input resolution P is involved, and no comparison roof is asserted.

source.place: Local Koszul complex in the proof; Tag 068C finite-free quotient resolution; reindexing and chart pushforward provide a carrier on Y.

proof.text: Identify the restricted closed subscheme with Spec(A/I) and apply exists_affine_quotient_sheafified_resolution to Q.complex and Q.pi. Reindex chain degree n as cochain degree -n, inserting zero in positive degrees. This gives B on U augmented quasi-isomorphically to F(S).

Using hQ, the exterior basis of A^m makes B^{-n} free of rank binomial(m,n), and exterior powers vanish above m. A bounded-above complex of flat module sheaves is K-flat. Put K equal to termwise pushforward of B along U.ι and use the natural isomorphism restricting that pushforward back to B to transport the augmentation and K-flatness; no exactness of pushforward is asserted.

On W the restriction of tensor pullback of K equals the restricted tensor pullback of B. Verify this termwise by the inverse-image and scalar-extension formula. Each f_j maps to zero in A/I since span(range f)=I, so each contraction differential becomes zero. Scalar extension and restriction preserve the displayed free bases and the bounds [-m,0]. Empty sequences give the unit in degree zero; empty charts and zero quotients give zero modules with the same constructions.

theorem exists_local_koszul_augmented_carrier
    {Z Y : Scheme.{u}} (i : Z ⟶ Y) [IsClosedImmersion i]
    [(Scheme.Modules.tensorPullback i).Additive]
    (V : Z.Opens) (U : Y.affineOpens) (m : ℕ) (f : Fin m → Γ(Y, U.1))
    (hf : Ideal.span (Set.range f) = i.ker.ideal U)
    (Q : ProjectiveResolution (ModuleCat.of (Γ(Y, U.1) : Type u)
      ((Γ(Y, U.1) : Type u) ⧸ i.ker.ideal U)))
    (hQ : Q.complex = ExteriorAlgebra.koszulComplex (Γ(Y, U.1) : Type u) m f) :
    let F := (Scheme.Modules.restrictFunctor U.1.ι).mapHomologicalComplex (.up ℤ)
    let S := (HomologicalComplex.single Y.Modules (.up ℤ) 0).obj
      ((Scheme.Modules.pushforward i).obj (SheafOfModules.unit Z.ringCatSheaf))
    let G := (Scheme.Modules.tensorPullback i).mapHomologicalComplex (.up ℤ) ⋙
      moduleOpenOverComplexFunctor Z V (V.ι ⁻¹ᵁ (i ⁻¹ᵁ U.1))
    ∃ (K : CochainComplex Y.Modules ℤ) (b : F.obj K ⟶ F.obj S),
      CochainComplex.IsKFlatResolution (R := U.1.toScheme.sheaf) b ∧
      (∀ x y : ℤ, (G.obj K).d x y = 0) ∧
      (∃ x y : ℤ, ∀ k : ℤ, k < x ∨ y < k → IsZero ((G.obj K).X k)) ∧
      (∀ k : ℤ, ∃ r : ℕ, Nonempty ((G.obj K).X k ≅
        SheafOfModules.free (R := V.toScheme.ringCatSheaf.over
          (V.ι ⁻¹ᵁ (i ⁻¹ᵁ U.1))) (ULift.{u} (Fin r))))
